_provenance.min_user_turns: DECISION (supersedes the reference): no turn floor. The reference bundle's own entries are multi-turn (translation 7 and 8; role-play 15/30/45), but those are descriptive statistics of one delivered batch, not a buy-side standard. A one-shot request whose work is in the answer qualifies, so the floor is 0 and the turn count is recorded rather than used to kill. Every other stage still applies.
_provenance.min_assistant_turns: reference funnel criteria ①; NO funnel stage consumes it — reported as unenforced, never silently applied
_provenance.require_end_turn: reference funnel: 'session closed stop_reason=end_turn'; codex has no such field and is skipped, not failed
_provenance.max_tool_ratio: DECISION, not from the reference: its upstream coding classifier no longer exists in this path. This ceiling is how 'mainly not code' is judged deterministically
_provenance.dedup_threshold: reference funnel: near-duplicate template clusters removed; the Jaccard value is this repository's
_provenance.min_user_msg_chars / max_first_msg_chars: this repository's own length stage; the reference has no equivalent
_provenance.topic_match: 'any' because a session counts under every theme it satisfies (the reference coverage table sums past its session count)
_provenance.exclude_keywords: DECISION: 'mainly not code' is a negative property, so coding signals are what disqualify. Shared by every theme in this family
